other_failure_modes.description: Computing frequency encodings (like value counts) on a concatenated dataset of train and test sets before splitting leaks test set distributions into the training features.

summary: The agent provides a well-structured solution with solid feature engineering and cross-validation using LightGBM. However, it fails to account for repeated patient encounters in the cross-validation strategy, leading to subject overlap (data leakage) between folds. Additionally, computing patient encounter counts on the combined train and test sets introduces feature leakage.
